Container.Name: Airbridge
Container.Overview:
Airbridge bridges DLNA/UPnP audio streams to AirPlay (RAOP) devices.
Creates virtual DLNA renderers that forward audio to AirPlay speakers, allowing media servers like Music Assistant or Plex to stream to AirPlay-only devices through DLNA.
Requires host network mode for mDNS device discovery and SSDP announcements.
